name = "acme/host-var"
version = "1.0.0"
[sandbox]
env = { KEY = "${OPENAI_API_KEY}", MODE = "fast", BOTH = "${A}${B:-x}" }

[[sandbox.services]]
name = "db"
image = "postgres"
env = { P = "${PGPASS}" }

[stages.two]
unlock = "on_submit"

[stages.two.agent]
network = "none"

diagnostics.message: sandbox.env.KEY resolves ${OPENAI_API_KEY} from the host; a runtime resolves it only if the operator allows that variable, and never a provider key: a seat that calls a model gets the runtime's proxy and a scoped token instead

sandbox.env.BOTH resolves ${A} from the host; a runtime resolves it only if the operator allows that variable, and never a provider key: a seat that calls a model gets the runtime's proxy and a scoped token instead

sandbox.env.BOTH resolves ${B} from the host; a runtime resolves it only if the operator allows that variable, and never a provider key: a seat that calls a model gets the runtime's proxy and a scoped token instead

sandbox.services.0.env.P resolves ${PGPASS} from the host; a runtime resolves it only if the operator allows that variable, and never a provider key: a seat that calls a model gets the runtime's proxy and a scoped token instead
